title: Pool Lap Log Lap Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pool:lap lap_count=*
| stats sum(lap_count) as total_value, avg(lap_count) as avg_value by pool_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks pool values by total and average lap count across pool lap log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `lap_count` values for each pool lap log event and review total and average lap count by pool.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total lap count.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which pool shows the biggest lap count numbers in your pool lap log data.
